title: Cranial modification told to have been ordered by the gods

tellings.quote: one group uh a paper by gson and gson from 1995 where they interviewed them and said why why do you do this and they said because our ancestors were instructed by the gods to do this

plain: Some peoples who reshaped their children's skulls, binding them so the head grows long, said they did it because the gods told their ancestors to. The researcher Mike Masters tells Michels this, citing a 1995 paper by two authors named Gerszten, who he says asked a group why they did it and were told "our ancestors were instructed by the gods to do this." Masters brings it up because, if the answer is taken at face value, it would tie a practice found around the world, including among the Maya, to beings the people believed were above them.
